messages:
maria: Heads-up — external pen test next week. Need to confirm remediation SLA, rollforward plan if a P1 appears, and who owns evidence packaging + log snapshots. Also have KMS access questions.

sam: @maria sounds right. Contractually we promised 72h for P1 remediation. Rollforward = emergency rollback + hotfix path. I can own rollback playbook. Do assessors pull CloudTrail or do we provide exports?

eva: We normally give a pre-signed S3 bundle + timeboxed read-only bucket. For KMS, we issue ephemeral grants (short-lived) and rotate after the window. RBAC for assessors: ephemeral STS scoped to read-only logs only.

jack: Important — no permanent IAM roles for third parties. Use ephemeral STS + session tags. Example minimal S3 policy we can hand to assessors: 

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:ListBucket"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*"]
    }
  ]
}
```

maria: Also need KMS audit surface: CloudTrail should capture Decrypt/GenerateDataKey calls. We must ensure KMS logs are forwarded to the SIEM and retention is ok. @ops-bot can you confirm current retention?

ops-bot: Auto-response — KMS key usage is logged by CloudTrail and forwarded to Splunk index "kms_audit". Retention: 90d hot, 365d cold by default. For >365d retention open INF ticket.

sam: Let's schedule a dry-run Fri 09:00 UTC. During dry-run we hand over presigned bundle + ephemeral KMS grants and run the rollforward/rollback drill. @eva can you produce the playbook + checklist?

eva: Yep. I'll include the presign steps and verification commands, plus revoke instructions: 

```bash
# revoke a grant after use
aws kms revoke-grant --key-id alias/pt-key --grant-id <grant-id>

# generate presigned S3 object (example)
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-evidence/{bundle}.tar.gz --expires-in 86400
```

I'll also add sha256 hashes for object integrity and an ops verification step to publish them to the ticket.

maria: Who's doing retest triage? Need point person to ack fixes and verify logs/shas. Prefer jack primary, sam fallback.

jack: I can be primary. I'll create the post-engagement triage board and a retest checklist (verify fix, verify logs, validate KMS usage entries).

sam: I'll update the SLA clause in the vendor contract to reflect 72h P1 and include rollback/communication SLAs. Also add auto-fallback policy if infra changes cause latency > SLO.

maria: Actions recap — 1) sam: contract + rollback playbook 2) eva: playbook + presign + revoke steps 3) jack: triage board + retest checklist 4) ops: confirm CloudTrail/KMS forwarding and retention. Dry-run Fri 09:00 UTC. I'll DM vendor and confirm acceptance. :thumbsup:

jack: I'll post the triage board link here once created. Friday dry-run invite pls.

eva: adding a small checklist for evidence packaging: include full CloudTrail export, kube-audit dumps, worker logs (last 48h), and manifest with sha256 values.

maria: perfect — thanks everyone. We'll iterate on the playbook in this thread.
